8,805 likes, 179 comments - passionpassport on April 28, 2022: "Visit Moraine Lake, nestled in the striking Valley of the Ten Peaks, Once featured on the back of Canada's twenty dollar bill. With vivid turquoise waters set against a backdrop of glaciers it is no wonder Lake Louise and Moraine Lake are among the most popular destinations in the Canadian Rockies. As with many bucket list Rockies destinations, exploring beyond the main viewpoints will lead to unique and secluded experiences.⁠
⁠
📸 @argenel⁠
#passionpassport #banff #lakemoraine".
